title: Hajj journey map and set passage 2:197-199
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: Sawm, Zakah and Khums, Hajj (3.3 to 3.5)
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y10 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Hajj journey map and set passage 2:197-199)
intro: Lesson 30: 3.5 Key actions of Hajj (Qur'an 2:197-199). To understand the key actions of Hajj in order and what the set passage 2:197-199 teaches about conduct during Hajj

questions.q: Describe the key actions of Hajj on the 10th of Dhul-Hijjah. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Stone Jamrat al-'Aqabah; offer the sacrifice; shave or trim the hair; tawaf al-ifadah (and sa'i).
questions.model: One mark per action, in order: 1) stoning the big jamrah; 2) sacrifice; 3) shaving or trimming; 4) tawaf al-ifadah.

questions.q: Set passage task in the portal response box (6 marks, our own question): 'Explain what Qur'an 2:197-199 teaches about conduct during Hajj.' Three developed points. Start: 'Firstly, 2:197 teaches that ...'
questions.a: Avoiding rafath, sin and arguing (2:197); taqwa as the best provision (2:197); remembering Allah and seeking forgiveness (2:198-199); trade allowed (2:198)
questions.model: Teacher writes point 1: 'Firstly, 2:197 teaches that pilgrims must avoid sin and arguing. This means Hajj trains patience with millions of people in crowded places.'

questions.q: the 12-mark for independent study: 'The benefits of Hajj outweigh its challenges.' Write the plan.
questions.a: For: forgiveness, unity, equality; against: cost, crowds, health; judgement
